title: Mihin aikaan: answering with clock times
focus: Mihin aikaan asks at what time. Mihin aikaan sinä tulet? — Tulen kello kaksi.
targetSkills: Mihin aikaan: answering with clock times

exercises.prompt: Choose the question meaning “At what time are you coming?”  Address one person (sinä).
exercises.explanation: Singular refers to one person or one thing in these patterns. A stem is the part of a word to which an ending is attached. The illative is an into/to form; mihin aikaan uses that form in a time expression. Mihin aikaan asks at what time. Here the phrase asks about time rather than a destination. Use the complete phrase before the supplied clause. Milloin can also request a clock time; mihin aikaan makes that request explicit. The complete question means “At what time are you coming”.
requiredSkills: Mihin aikaan: answering with clock times
exercises.targetSkill: Mihin aikaan: answering with clock times

parts.role: subject (who or what this sentence is about)
